answer: Run a decaying berth auction: plume is one clone, wharf the only register where a key, host route and lease share one berth, so twins collide. Each epoch wharf releases one indivisible lane; the kth live plume must re-buy lane k and burn k quartz, metered watt-hours locked to that berth before expiry. n plume need n serial releases and n(n+1)/2 quartz per epoch, with no sharing or subdivision. It fails when wharf pools lanes, replays releases, or quartz moves.
